chose: weigh each restatement by the summed bits of what its copies share, under the project's own tokens and TypeScript's library typings, with one threshold of 18 bits
over: the 16-character cut for values and three shared members for sets
because: the four design reports converged on rarity: the cut missed short rare facts (PostInvocation, .mts) and kept long common ones; one threshold over bits treats a literal, a set and a predicate alike
binding: none: this session owns no active work order

chose: declare a copy different on purpose by a comment at the copy (// differs on purpose from <home>: <how>), counted apart, refused for a copy written the same
over: a journal dismissal per different-on-purpose restatement
because: a restatement has no record id to dismiss, and the comment travels with the code and names a checkable difference; an identical copy has no difference to name
binding: none: this session owns no active work order

because: f023d73e lists PostInvocation as an event Antigravity's hooks file writes flat; Coherence installs no handler for it, so it does not belong in ANTIGRAVITY_EVENTS, and dropping it would change how install rewrites a project's own PostInvocation handlers; the type holds the other three to the events Coherence installs and names the fourth apart
binding: none: this session owns no active work order

chose: witness a test's hold in query mirrors --witness, run in CI's Restatements step and cached by the home, copy and test blobs; the reading says held, not yet refuted, until then
over: count a naming test as a hold
because: a witness runs the project's tests twice per copy, which no session reading or hook can afford, and a test that names a copy without noticing a change holds nothing
binding: none: this session owns no active work order

chose: keep restatement advice out of the hooks in #193: no PreToolUse lookup, no Bash re-check, no Stop sweep; CI's --base names what was born since the base
over: edit-time advice from a warm index
because: an edit-time message needs high precision and a warm index the server does not keep yet; on the four target repos the reading's top twenty still mix real copies with UI copy and example apps, and a false alarm trains agents to ignore the channel; the never-in-a-hook invariant stays as it is
binding: none: this session owns no active work order

chose: leave map conflicts and writer/reader round trips out of the detector
over: report a functional-dependency conflict between tables
match a writer's format against a reader's pattern
because: both need value-level comparison (extension to kind against extension to language) or reading a call's output format (randomBytes(4).toString(hex) as [0-9a-f]{8}), which the predicate probes do not give cheaply; the shard token is caught by its rule instead
